oracle: Observe fresh host state before a user edit; preserve externally changed text, replace only currently selected text, and never reuse correction/space undo provenance across a fresh caret or external edit.

cases.sequence: Type a composing word, externally move caret with fresh callback, then space/delete.
cases.expect: Operate at new caret and do not undo/rewrite old composition.

cases.sequence: Create automatic space or correction provenance, externally insert/delete adjacent text with fresh callback, then backspace.
cases.expect: Delete current host character; stale undo cannot replace external text.

cases.sequence: Create composing/correction provenance, externally select another range, then type/space/backspace.
cases.expect: Only current selected range is replaced/deleted; prior composition cannot be committed over it.

cases.sequence: Create phantom-space provenance, externally edit or move caret into unrelated text, then type punctuation/word.
cases.expect: No space is inserted solely because provenance belonged to old destination.

limits: A permanently or indistinguishably delayed host proxy cannot establish actual caret identity; such cases must be labeled ambiguous rather than regressions.
restrictions: Read-only source/tests until root authorization; /tmp experiments allowed; exclude dictation, ranking, language caching, Spanish key UX.
